text: whatever changes have been made now are making the textures retain 'better', i can rotate the camera more without it breaking, but it still has break points
resolution: Continued the compiled camera-breakpoint rendering fix. Retained static instance uploads are now all-or-nothing so streamed subranges beyond MAX_STATIC_INSTANCES fall back to the dynamic subrange path instead of clamping to zero; the dynamic instance staging cap was raised from 65,536 to 262,144 rows for dense streamed camera views. Added static upload policy test and verified no-JS loader screenshot builds/renders.
